title: @nocopypaste/vue-grid grid config
description: A <VGrid> configuration as data: its props (camelCase), `columns` and the `features` it registers (export names, e.g. "sortingFeature"). Functions and components are allowed where the API takes them but are not checked. Validate fully with validateGridConfig() from @nocopypaste/vue-grid/agent.

rows.description: The rows (client data), used as-is and never mutated. Omit when using `dataSource`.

rowKey.description: Stable unique id of a row: a property name or `(row) => string | number`. All row state is keyed by it.

features.description: Registered features by export name (per grid and app-wide together).

dataSource.description: Server data: called with the current query (sort, filters, search, page) whenever it changes. The grid cancels superseded requests, shows loading and errors, and sorts / filters / pages nothing itself.

pagination.description: Built-in pagination under the grid (server-side with `dataSource`, client-side otherwise).

statusBar.description: A status bar under the grid (status bar feature): rows that pass the filters ("84 of 200 rows"), selected rows, active filters with Clear; `{ summary: ['total'] }` adds the sum and average of those columns over the selected rows. `#status-bar` replaces its content.

parts.description: Built-in parts to leave out (`{ progressBar: false }`), over `createVueGrid({ parts })`.

sortMode.description: `controlled` (default): a header click only updates `v-model:sort` (sort on the server or in your own code). `client`: the grid sorts the rows itself. Ignored with `dataSource`.

filterMode.description: `client` (default): the grid filters its rows. `controlled`: it only emits `update:filters`.

filterRow.description: Show the filter row: an input under each filterable column's header.

filterStorage.description: Persist the filter model (`string` = localStorage key).

noMatchText.description: Shown when filters hide every row. Default: `messages.noMatch`, else `No rows match the current filters.`

selectable.description: A selection column: `true` = multi-select (with select-all), `'single'` = one row.

selectionMode.description: `cascade` (default): selecting a parent selects its children. `independent`: rows alone.

isRowSelectable.description: Rows that can't be selected get a disabled checkbox.

pruneSelection.description: Drop selected keys whose rows are no longer in the data (after a reload, a delete, a new server page). Default: keys are kept, so a selection can span server pages.

subRows.description: Synchronous child rows of a row: shown in a nested sub-grid when expanded.

loadSubRows.description: Lazy child rows, loaded on first expand (cached, with loading / error / retry).

hasSubRows.description: With `loadSubRows`: which rows get an expander (default: every row).

rowExpandable.description: With a `#detail` slot: which rows can expand to show it (default: every row).

rowClickable.description: Pointer cursor on rows (`row-click` is emitted either way).

highlightedRows.description: Keys of rows to highlight (e.g. the row being edited).

flash.description: Briefly highlight cells whose value changes (live data, enrichment). Columns can override.

overscan.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport. Default 6.

detailHeight.description: Estimated height in px of a detail row (`#detail` slot) until it has been rendered and measured. Default 4 × `rowHeight`. Data rows always have `rowHeight`.

virtual.description: Virtual scrolling: only the rows in view render. Rows share one height (`rowHeight`, px) and the grid needs a bounded height. Needs the virtual scrolling feature.

storage.description: Persist column state (order, hidden, pins, widths): a localStorage key or your own storage.

pinnedMaxShare.description: Pinned columns scroll like the others while together they'd take more than this share of the grid's width (a phone, a narrow panel); pinned again once there's room. `false`: always pinned. Column pinning feature.

renderers.description: Renderers usable by name in this grid (merged over the app-wide ones).

locale.description: Locale for number / date renderers (default: the plugin's, else the browser's).

currency.description: Default ISO 4217 currency for currency renderers.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for date renderers and date filters.

loading.description: Shows a progress bar and sets `aria-busy` (server data sets it by itself).

emptyText.description: Shown when there are no rows. Default: `messages.empty`, else `No data to show.`

ui.description: Extra classes per part (`root`, `header`, `headerCell`, `row`, `cell`, `subgrid`, `detail`, `empty`), e.g. Tailwind utilities.

contextMenu.description: Right-click menu items for a body cell. Return `null`/`[]` to keep the browser's menu.

headerMenu.description: Header right-click menu: `true` = built-in items (sort, pin, move, hide, reset), `false` = off, or a function that receives the built-in items and returns the items to show.

pinnedTopRows.description: Extra rows above the body, not part of the data (row pinning feature).

pinnedBottomRows.description: Extra rows below the body, not part of the data (row pinning feature).

totals.description: A totals row with each column's `aggregate` (aggregation feature): `true` / `'bottom'` sticks it to the bottom, `'top'` under the header.

totalsLabel.description: The totals row's label, in its first column (unless that column has an aggregate). Default: `messages.total`, else `Total`.

aggregates.description: Totals row values by column key, instead of computing them (e.g. totals from a server).

groupsExpanded.description: Groups start expanded (row grouping feature). Default: collapsed.

multiSort.description: Multi-column sort (sorting feature): Shift-click (or Shift+Enter) on a header adds it as the next key, Shift-click again turns it descending, then removes it. `v-model:sorts` holds every key, `v-model:sort` the first; server queries get `sorts` too.

sort.description: Sort state: a header click cycles asc → desc → none. Header UI needs the sorting feature.

sorts.description: Every sort key, the first one first (`multi-sort`). `sort` is the first of them.

order.description: Column keys in display order (all known columns, visible or not).

pinned.description: Runtime pin overrides (e.g. from the header menu). `null` = explicitly unpinned; a missing key falls back to the column's `pinned` definition. Optional so older persisted state still loads.

widths.description: Widths the user resized columns to (CSS lengths, e.g. `'240px'`). Column resizing feature.

columnState.description: Column order, hidden columns, runtime pins and resized widths (persisted with `storage`).

expanded.description: Keys of expanded rows (sub-grids and detail rows).

selected.description: Keys of selected rows. Needs the selection feature.

filters.description: Column filters and quick search: `{ columns: Record<key, ColumnFilter>, search }`. Needs the filtering feature.

page.description: Current page (1-based); resets to 1 when sort or filters change. Needs the pagination feature.

pageSize.description: Rows per page. Needs the pagination feature.

top.description: Keys of the rows pinned above the body, in display order.

bottom.description: Keys of the rows pinned below the body, in display order.

pinnedRows.description: Top-level rows pinned above / below the body, by key: `{ top, bottom }`. Needs the row pinning feature.

groupBy.description: Column keys to group the rows by, outermost first (`['region', 'status']`, or one key). Group rows show the value, the row count and the columns' aggregates. Needs the row grouping feature.

selectAllMatching.description: Server data: every row matching the query is selected, not just the loaded ones (set from the "Select all N rows" banner; ends when filters change or a row is unticked). Act on the query then, not on `selected`. Needs the selection feature.

selectedGroups.description: Server data with row grouping: groups selected by query, by their paths, without loading their rows (a group's checkbox). Act on these with `selected` and the filters. Ends when the filters or the grouping change. Needs the selection and row grouping features.

key.description: Unique, stable column id. Also used for sort state, column state and slot names.

field.description: Dot path into the row, e.g. `user.address.city`. Defaults to `key`.

value.description: Computes the cell value; wins over `field`.

renderer.description: A renderer definition (`currencyRenderer`), a registered renderer name, or a component. Defaults to `text`. Built-in names: text, toggle-text, number, signed-number, currency, change, date, datetime, boolean, status, link, icon, json, json-tree, actions-menu, action-button, multi-line, copy, chip, checkbox, switch, radio, edit, image, code, button-group, icon-toggle, details, list.

rendererOptions.description: Options of the column's renderer, typed against it (merged over the renderer's defaults).

width.description: Any CSS grid track size. Defaults to `auto`.

minWidth.description: Lower bound; combined with `width` into `minmax(minWidth, width)`, and the resize minimum.

maxWidth.description: Upper bound when the user resizes the column (column resizing feature).

resizable.description: Can the user resize this column (column resizing feature)? Default `true`.

group.description: Header group label (column groups feature): adjacent visible columns with the same `group` share one header cell above their own headers.

align.description: Cell and header alignment (default: the renderer's, e.g. `end` for numbers, else `start`).

sortable.description: A sort button in the header (sorting feature). Client sorting needs `sort-mode="client"`.

sortValue.description: The value client sorting compares (default: the renderer's sort value, else the cell value).

sortFn.description: A full comparator for client sorting; wins over `sortValue`.

pinned.description: Initial pin side (the header menu can change it at runtime unless `pinnable: false`).

pinnable.description: Can the user pin/unpin it from the header menu? Default `true`.

hidden.description: Initial visibility (column state wins once it exists).

hideable.description: Can the user hide it from the column menu? Default `true`.

reorderable.description: Can the user move it? Default `true`.

filterable.description: Show a filter for this column (funnel in the header, and an input in the filter row).

options.description: Choices for a `set` filter: a list, or a loader called with the search text (e.g. from a backend — honour `signal`). Default: distinct values from the rows.

filter.description: Filter type — default from the renderer (number, date, boolean, set for status/chip, else text) — or options.

filterValue.description: Value used for filtering (default: the cell value).

filterFn.description: Custom predicate; replaces the built-in matching for this column.

filterComponent.description: Custom filter UI (popover), receives `modelValue` / emits `update:modelValue` with a filter.

searchable.description: Include in the quick search. Default `true` for visible columns.

flash.description: Briefly highlight the cell when its value changes (overrides the grid's `flash` prop). `'direction'`: green when a number goes up, red when it goes down.

aggregate.description: The column's value in the totals row (aggregation feature): `'sum' | 'avg' | 'min' | 'max'` over the cell values (empty values skipped), `'count'` of rows, or a function of the values and the rows. Shown with the column's renderer (`count` as a plain number).

groupable.description: The header menu offers Group by / Ungroup for this column (row grouping feature). Any column can be grouped through `v-model:group-by`; this only adds the menu items.

groupValue.description: The value rows are grouped by (row grouping feature), e.g. `(row) => row.placedAt.slice(0, 7)` for months. Default: the cell value, shown with the column's renderer; a `groupValue` is shown as text (or with the `#group-<key>` slot).

exportValue.description: The value exports and copying use (export feature), e.g. a plain id for a link or an object. Wins over the cell value and the renderer's text.

exportable.description: Included in CSV exports and copied rows (export feature)? Default `true`; set `false` on action columns.

cellClass.description: Extra classes for the column's body cells (or a function of the row).

headerClass.description: Extra classes for the column's header cell.
